claims: The 130th Boston Marathon was on April 20, 2026.
The men's course record is 2:01:52, set by Kenya's John Korir.
The women's course record is 2:17:22, set by Kenya's Sharon Lokedi in 2025.
John Korir broke the previous men's record of 2:03:02.
The previous men's record of 2:03:02 was held by Geoffrey Mutai since 2011.
As of April 21, 2026, the Boston Marathon Men's Open course record is 2:01:52 by John Korir (KEN) in 2026.
As of April 21, 2026, the Boston Marathon Women's Open course record is 2:17:22 by Sharon Lokedi (KEN) in 2025.
As of April 21, 2026, the Boston Marathon Men's Wheelchair course record is 1:16:06 by Marcel Hug (SUI) in 2025.
As of April 21, 2026, the Boston Marathon Women's Wheelchair course record is 1:33:17 by Manuela Schär (SUI) in 2017.
John Korir won the 2026 Boston Marathon with 2:01:52.
John Korir's 2:01:52 is the fifth-fastest marathon time of all time globally.
The 2026 Boston Marathon featured multiple runners finishing under the previous course record.
The Boston Marathon course has a point-to-point, net-downhill layout.
Times achieved on the Boston Marathon course are not eligible for world record status.
Times achieved on the Boston Marathon course are official course records.
